items.briefing:
Cybersecurity leaders are warning that insider threats are becoming more sophisticated, with trusted employees increasingly exploiting their access — intentionally or accidentally. Separately, large organisations globally are being targeted by fake merger and acquisition scams, where criminals impersonate executives or advisers to trick staff into transferring funds or sharing sensitive information. Australian organisations involved in any M&A activity should be especially vigilant right now.

Growing AI use is also placing new strain on organisational networks, which can create security gaps if infrastructure isn't kept up to date. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email about a merger, acquisition, or urgent financial request, verify it directly with your manager by phone before taking any action.

featured.title: AI adoption puts pressure on campus and branch networks
featured.summary: Most organisations are unprepared for AI traffic surges, with 73% expecting campus and branch network capacity limits within two years.
